# Quaternius Ultimate Monsters

- Author: Quaternius
- Official source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemonsters.html
- Official download folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18m4KpzpEzhC9wl7jzr6dUc0N8Jozr79C
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Local proof: `LICENSE.txt`, copied from the pack’s `License.txt`.

## Selected models

- `BlueDemon.glb`: animated lower-mountain demon;
- `Ghost_Skull.glb`: animated flying wraith;
- `Yeti.glb`: animated upper-mountain guardian.

The official glTF files were converted to self-contained GLB files with glTF
Transform 4.3.0. Their named idle, locomotion, attack, hit-reaction, and death
clips are preserved and selected directly at runtime.
